turn_model.architecture: frame-synchronous dual-head streaming ASR plus turn-state prediction over shared Voxtral Realtime representations
turn_model.policy_boundary: Upstream explicitly describes labels as predictions rather than commands and recommends smoothing/policy over multiple frames.

language_support.trigger7_implication: Fails German-first production eligibility at source scope; no German production or benchmark credit may be minted.

upstream_turn_benchmark.delay_tradeoff: At tau 320 ms the model card reports lower complete-state accuracy but lower latency; this is an upstream tradeoff, not an F2 latency result.

runtime_and_security.quickstart_requirement: Linux + NVIDIA GPU with at least 24 GB VRAM for the documented Turn Demo path
runtime_and_security.vllm_overlay: Upstream pins an overlay to vLLM 0.19.1 commit b1388b1fbf5aaef47937fabe98931211684666a6 for turn.delta propagation.
runtime_and_security.full_duplex_demo_boundary: Full-duplex stack adds optional LLM/TTS and patched runtime; it is separate from the basic turn model and grants no F2 full-duplex credit.

hypothesis: The frame-synchronous shared-representation turn head is a high-value architecture donor for Frankenstein because its explicit speaking/turn_end/backchannel/uncertain state machine maps naturally onto WAIT, interruption and semantic endpointing without requiring a second persona or effect authority.
counterhypothesis: The turn head may encode language-specific semantic cues strongly enough that direct reuse on German degrades endpoint and backchannel behavior; its approximately-4B/24-GB-VRAM reference path may also be too expensive relative to a smaller German-specific endpoint model or deterministic VAD-plus-semantic policy.
next_discriminator: Do not dispatch this 4B checkpoint merely to test a language it does not claim. Extract the six-state frame-synchronous policy/ABI as a donor concept, and only reopen X2-Turn runtime work if upstream adds German support or an explicitly justified German adaptation/fine-tune lane receives its own semantic objective. Continue the existing Qwen3-ASR target-runtime claim only after its already-dispatched runner/control-plane gate resolves; do not duplicate that run.
